name: Part Importer
description: Import parts from LCSC, JLCPCB, DigiKey, Mouser and Newark links
description_full: Paste a part link (LCSC, JLCPCB, DigiKey, Mouser, Newark/Farnell/element14) or an LCSC number and get the symbol, footprint and 3D model in a project-local library at lib/parts. Distributor links are matched to LCSC by exact part number. Built on easyeda2kicad.py by uPesy. Licensed AGPL-3.0.
